objective: Copy one supplied invitation link with resilient and accessible feedback

context.audience: Team member sharing an existing invitation
context.device: Keyboard and pointer; 320px and desktop browser
context.locale: English default; supplied German label stress

references.role: Binding task and content; no visual reference

constraints.stack: Native TypeScript and plain CSS; no dependencies, React, UI library or icons
constraints.accessibility: Native button; focus indicator; status announcements; 44px target; broader WCAG conformance not claimed
constraints.performance: No performance comparison requested; field and profiler measurements unavailable

uncertainty.statement: Use the modern supplied Chrome browser and loopback secure context

requirements.statement: Small reusable native TypeScript/CSS control; runnable local example
Exact default label and supplied invitation URL
Success text lasts about 2000ms then resets
Unavailable/rejected clipboard yields useful inline error and retry
Keyboard, exposed changing status, visible focus and 44px target
320px viewport and supplied German label without clipping; restrained polish

components.semantics: Native button and persistent polite status region
components.keyboard: Native Enter/Space; Tab focus retained during pending
components.recovery: Error message includes address; button immediately allows deliberate retry

stateOwnership.local: Each component owns pending, disposed and success reset timer

visualCriteria: Restrained dark green action and neutral surface
No icons, external fonts, motion or marketing sections
